subject: Mathematics
questionText: Match the complex number locus equations in Column I with their corresponding geometric shapes in Column II:

column2: Q. Circle centered at origin with radius 1

solution:
A -> R (Sum of distances from two fixed points is constant $6 > 4 \implies$ Ellipse).
B -> S (Difference of distances is constant $3 < 4 \implies$ Hyperbola).
C -> P (Equidistant from $i$ and $-i \implies$ Perpendicular bisector, Real Axis $y=0$).
D -> Q ($\text{Re}((z-1)/(z+1)) = 0 \implies z$ subtends $90^\circ$ over diameter $[-1, 1] \implies$ Circle $|z|=1$).
